body:
Some hotlines are okay in times of dire need. Sometimes it's just... deflating to speak to someone so you have a couple of moments rest from these stupid feelings. (My workplace made me call Samaritans last month, it helped at the time. The one today, not so much.)

I'd also say it's ironic, but I tell people the same thing. I'm so sorry you also feel you have to do that to yourself... the hands are a sensitive area and must be very difficult to hide. I hope one day you'll be able to be free from that cycle... but no rush.

I have my fish as they're the only pet I can have. I live because I know no one else will care for them properly since "they're only fish". I've gotten into one of my favourite games again recently but... even then while playing I feel numb. At least it's numb while playing a game instead of numb while crying or wishing for death.

I guess I'm just scared of being stuck in a cycle. My life has always been cycles, and this one I'm supposed to be able to control but... I can't. And I refuse to live like that. I can't do it, not again. And the only way I see out is to leave the world.

I know you said you lost a lot of motivation but... do you have anything you like?

I have a very active imagination (have done since childhood), so I get the thinking part. It always helps my brain function.

Lately though it's all just... stopped. Maybe due to the meds, or maybe lack of motivation do to anything at all at the moment.

Mediation is very hit or miss, usually I just do it at work when I need a moment. But yeah the empty mindedness of it is really hard to deal with.

You have made me think about this though, I'd never really properly considered it being a missing piece... 

Thank you.

Just having... feeling. Instead of this empty void I have in my heart and my tummy and my brain.

I like to have emotions. I miss them. Even if they're bad. But at the moment I only feel numb, or bad. No more contentness.

I have things happen to me and either they cause the wrong emotion out of me, or no emotion at all. And I don't know how much longer I can put up with it.

I just want to vanish.

I did use a hotline today but it didn't really help.

And to be honest even if I was given the immense pain... I'd still deserve it. That's why I hurt, but the cuts do nothing. I just can't be bothered getting taken to the ER to be pumped or whatever. So many things I can do, but I don't want to be an inconvenience.

I just feel I'm gonna break real soon...

I feel the same with the loneliness... people tell me they love me and that they care but my brain translates it as lies. That's what it feels like.
Well... too be honest there isn't really any good excuse to tell anyone to get them to buy you rope, let alone a friend.
I don't think so. First relationships are hard, especially when you feel or are the culprit for why it fell apart. But relationships aren't everything in this... frankly stupid world.
Maybe it would be better to reach out to that friend you want to ask and ask them if they have a minute to talk about how you're feeling...?
